accuracy_is_misleading: the first model scored 0.889 accuracy, which sounds good, but only 50/470 queries are sign96 wins so the majority baseline ('always say BM25') is 0.894 - the router is worse than doing nothing. Accuracy is also the wrong metric: in 358 queries both methods score identically and the choice is irrelevant. The decision metric is FR@3 gain.
verdict: the ceiling is real (+5.49 pp noise-adjusted) but unreachable with these signals. All four model families produce NEGATIVE routing gain on held-out splits.
consistent_with: L-109 measured r=0.02 between lexical overlap and the method gap
